newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Equipment to acquire Gamko.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Equipment to acquire Gamko.

text.p: Specialty Equipment Cos Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire privately held Gamko Holding BV, Holland's largest manufacturer of refrigeration equipment for the beverage/beer cooler markets.
The purchase price for the business, which had 1996 calendar year sales of about $25 million, was not disclosed.
Gamko's product line includes beer and soft drink coolers, refrigeration units, a full line of beer dispensing equipment, refrigerators and mobile special event bars.

Specialty's agreement to acquire Gamko includes the purchase of CoolPart, a separate corporation engaged in the same business in Slovakia, The Czech Republic and Poland, the company said. CoolPart also has established a joint venture manufacturing and sales company in Thailand.
